title: project-me
summary: A personal data-science project with a cold-start augmentation script that trains a classifier on tabular data believed to suffer from class imbalance or scarce records. The script cold_start_ctgan_augment.py imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to fit and load a CTGAN model that generates synthetic rows to augment the training set.
